text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
This can't be real. How could I let this
happen?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I told myself I'd catch up to Prez! I was
supposed
to... to...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
How am I supposed to call myself
invincible after
this?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right. My story isn't over...
choice_data_list: まだ何もかも終わったわけじゃない

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: In fact, it's just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So I need you to keep training me! Train
me so
much that I won't lose to anyone...
ever again!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: テイオー様は、もう2度と負けないって

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I... won't lose again. I won't let anyone
ever pass
me again.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll prove that I really am invincible!
